<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/vitest.config.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **11** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8a88901be1c317e2e078e6d29f21efcae5b9485e` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `b9ac11818d0b6b638c2a55cbfe963440fb55f5e0` — the merge of head `669c95c49c9c91da2a186d4e8a93291390ce613a` into base `8a88901be1c317e2e078e6d29f21efcae5b9485e`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin b9ac11818d0b6b638c2a55cbfe963440fb55f5e0 && git checkout b9ac11818d0b6b638c2a55cbfe963440fb55f5e0
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 8a88901be1c317e2e078e6d29f21efcae5b9485e 669c95c49c9c91da2a186d4e8a93291390ce613a && git checkout -B drift-repro 8a88901be1c317e2e078e6d29f21efcae5b9485e && git merge --no-ff 669c95c49c9c91da2a186d4e8a93291390ce613a

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8a88901be1c317e2e078e6d29f21efcae5b9485e
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 8a88901be1c317e2e078e6d29f21efcae5b9485e` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021) · `marchtian` · `session_01Nk17Z26X5DB59iQztDBADH` · 2026-10-17T17:35Z · head `669c95c49c`. It lands through the merge queue once every check on this head is green.

- **Shape:** a draft PR to `main`; the first line is `Fixes #23890`, and it is the only closing keyword in the body. `Clause-②: no` is at a line start in the body and in the changeset. Card and PR assignee: `marchtian`. Not governed (`check-governed-merges`: 0 of 16 paths).
- **Premise, measured:** on `main`, `audit-plugin.ts` contributed two Setup entries onto `sys_audit_log`'s rows: `nav_audit_logs` (the object list) and `nav_audit_log_browser` (`audit:log`). The browser's presets and "Open as list" are at the console pin `5e15928b4631` (objectui#12667).
- **The change, read by the seat:**
  - **The contribution:** one entry, `{ id: 'nav_audit_logs', type: 'component', label: 'Audit Log', componentRef: 'audit:log', icon: 'scroll-text' }`.
  - **Why that id survives (the dev's measured readers):** the access-security checklist anchors on `audit-plugin.ts#nav_audit_logs`; objectui keys sidebar pins on the nav id; and objectui routes by `type` / `componentRef`, never by id (0 hits at the pin, control 1).
  - **The retired id:** `nav_audit_log_browser`'s labels and digests are removed, and it joins `DEAD_SETUP_NAV_IDS`.
- **Negative pin ablated:** a second Setup entry onto the object list was planted, and 2 of 3 cases went red (`expected [ nav_audit_logs, …(1) ] to deeply equal [ nav_audit_logs ]`). Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Public surface:** the built `.d.ts` of `platform-objects` (22 files) and `plugin-audit` (2) name neither id. The bundles are typed `TranslationData`, so no published type names the removed key, and `Clause-②: no` holds.
- **The PM hypothesis falsified, as reported:** `connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts` does not compose `plugin-audit`, so its `toHaveLength(32)` does not move. `check-app-nav-i18n.mjs` carries `nav_audit_logs` only as a self-test fixture. Neither file is edited.
- **Prose faces, each sentence checked against the diff:**
  - `content/docs/ui/setup-app.mdx`: the Diagnostics row reads "Audit Log — `plugin-audit`", and the notable-entries bullet describes the page, its presets and "Open as list". Both match the contribution.
  - `content/docs/permissions/record-view-auditing.mdx`: "Diagnostics › Audit Log … opens the audit browser, which offers that view as a preset" matches it too.
  - `access-security.json` `access-security.audit-log-browser` (revision 5 → 6): step 5 and its nav source line now name the one entry. No clause changes.
  - The changeset's four bullets match the diff: the ids, the four labels, and the ⌘K palette consequence, which is stated.
- **Seat ruling on the dev's open question (keep the docs and checklist commit `028b17966`): A, keep.** The change would leave two published pages and a QA step naming a menu entry that no longer exists, and os-dev's rule is that a published text the change makes false is fixed in it.
- **Out-of-surface files:** `plugin-audit/vitest.config.ts` (`check:registry-log-declared`'s own prescription) and the docs commit. The claim is amended on #23890, and the lanes are declared on their seat posts.
- **Gates on this head:** in progress at this read. 18 checks succeeded and 5 were skipped by design; Test Core 1/6 to 6/6, Build Core, Build Docs and the Lint and Type Check lanes were running. Locally, 98 derived families, 98 exit 0.
- **Accepted deviations:** `origin/main` moved to `8a88901be` after the pre-PR merge, with no shared file. `test:repo` is CI's.
- **Out-of-scope findings:** Acceptance notes only:
  - Setup's ⌘K palette no longer searches audit rows, which follows from the ruling's "not from the nav" and is stated in the changeset;
  - item 4's re-measure belongs to whichever of #23890 and #23933 lands last (#23933 is open);
  - a still-true comment in `setup-nav.contributions.ts`.
